name: primitive-intersected-with-object-types-published
description: A library's published function that returns a string intersected with an object type publishes none of the object type's members, because a value of the type is a string at runtime and an outside program holding it holds no such member, so a member nothing references is reported as unused at certain. A published function that returns a plain object type publishes its members, so the one nothing references is reported at possible, as the published functions are where the run holds no consumer information.
